rubrics_metrics.name: Lemon muffins recipe
rubrics_metrics.description: Ingredients and proportions given: Juice of one lemon; 1/2 cup lard; 1 egg, beaten; 1/4 cup sugar; 4 teaspoons baking powder; 1 cup milk; 2 cups flour; 1/2 teaspoon salt. Method: Cream lard, sugar and salt together. Add egg, then milk, last baking powder and flour sifted together three times, then lemon juice. Beat until smooth.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Bake in hot oven about 25 minutes. Yield: from 12 to 15 muffins. (Exact oven temperature not specified; emphasis on thorough sifting and beating until smooth.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Orange banana salad recipe
rubrics_metrics.description: Ingredients and portions given for 6 servings: 6 oranges, 2 to 3 bananas, lettuce. Method: Peel oranges removing skin down to juicy pulp; cut in slices and cut slices in half. Peel bananas and slice them. On individual salad plates covered with beds of shredded lettuce, arrange alternately half slices of oranges and banana slices. Centre with a pat of boiled dressing and a banana or cherry if desired.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Serves 6. Presentation guidance: use beds of shredded lettuce and centre with boiled dressing; optional garnish with banana or cherry.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pattern No. 745 sizing and yardage requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Style No. 745 is designed for sizes 14, 16 and 18 years, and 36, 38, 40 and 42 inches bust. Size 36 requires 4 yards of 39-inch material with 1/8 yard of 39-inch contrasting (page text: 'Size 36 requires 4 yards of 39-inch material with % yard of 89-inch contrasting.' interpreted as yardage specification).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Pattern price 20 cents. Pattern is supplied with small back view for design details (drop shoulder covering upper arm). Suggested fabrics listed (striped or checked seersucker, pique, linen, shirting cottons, plaided gingham, tub pastel silks, printed sateen).

rubrics_metrics.name: How to order patterns
rubrics_metrics.description: Ordering procedure: send pattern number and size; price 20 cents in stamps or coin (coin preferred); wrap coin carefully. Address provided: Winnipeg New (176 McDermot Ave.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include pattern number and size on order form. Prefer coin to stamps and take care to wrap coin carefully to avoid damage. (Exact postal instructions and full address layout are provided on the page.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Preventing spontaneous combustion (oil-soaked rags)
rubrics_metrics.description: Safety note describing spontaneous combustion: rags soaked with drying oils (linseed oil and turpentine) combine with oxygen; because rags are poor conductors of heat, heat can accumulate until kindling temperature is reached and fire starts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Practical advice: do not leave oil-soaked rags lying about; place them in a metal can or, better still, burn them. Examples of incidents: fires in coal bunkers, hay stacks, and beach-wrecked whale carcasses can arise from slow oxidation with heat accumulation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Saddle ash tray functional requirement (fire prevention device)
rubrics_metrics.description: Description of a device invented to prevent forest fires by smokers: an ash tray which can be attached to the saddles of trail ponies in such a position as to permit riders to deposit pipe ashes, used matches and cigarette stubs instead of allowing them to drop to the ground.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Design intent and functional criterion: secure attachment to saddle in accessible position for rider, capacity to receive hot ashes and stubs, and thereby prevent ignition of surrounding ground. (No technical drawings or materials specified on page.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Recreation and health guidance (golf as example)
rubrics_metrics.description: Advice that recreational activities should not upset normal physical balance: example given of a golfer whose blood pressure rose dramatically while playing due to taking the game too seriously and playing for high stakes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guideline: play hobbies and pastimes for relaxation; avoid excessive intensity, high stakes, breaking equipment in anger. 'Just drive the ball and follow through.' Warning that permitting hobbies to upset physical balance can needlessly endanger health.
